elevate.move: Make the signature move once with meaning: DrawSVG the #services house section in (roof, walls, garage run), then light the room cells in turn with the same brass current line that later runs panel-to-charger in #ev, so one wire visibly travels room to room through the page; static end state for reduced motion.

Give the drawn vignettes one light source and a sequence: hero room at dusk, attic under a work lamp, porch at night with the switched porch light on, with the hero lamp echoed in each, so they read as one house over one evening rather than three separate scenes.
